answer: Agents selling ember alerts, ocean forecasts or nectar yield estimates govern their marketplace through stake-weighted votes: each vote’s weight equals the tokens its signer locks in escrow, not the number of accounts it controls. Splitting one stake among a thousand identities buys no extra influence. To dominate voting, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more stake than honest voters; provably conflicting signed votes trigger forfeiture of the offending stake.
